about_the_game:
ZERO GRAVITY HEROES

3 arcade challenges. 1 heroic mission.
Land, jetpack, and shoot your way through 90 bite-sized stages across 30 unique missions.
Fast-paced, family-friendly action inspired by classic arcade gameplay — built for modern players.

Your Mission

The Universal Defense Grid has collapsed, scattering fragments of a lost galactic map across 30 perilous sectors.
As an Elite Quantum Pilot, you must complete three distinct challenges on each planet to recover the pieces and restore order.

Core Gameplay

• Lunar Lander – Master precision landing in descent challenges filled with hazards and tight tunnels.
• Jetpack Platforming – Navigate traps, scavenge fuel, and escape before time runs out.
• Top-Down Shooter – Blast through orbital defenses and evade hostile threats.

Key Features

• 3 Games in 1 – Lander, Jetpack, and Shooter microgames in every level.
• 90 Fast-Paced Stages – 30 unique missions with 3 arcade-style stages each.
• Unlock the Final Mission – Collect 30 hidden puzzle pieces to restore the shattered cosmic map.
• Family-Friendly & Accessible – No violence, no mature content — fun for all ages.

Suit up and launch in.
The galaxy needs a hero. Will it be you?
